summary: Family foundry (95 staff, EUR 14.8 M); we are 7.1 % of its turnover, so we matter. Power and material bought forward until December 2028: it will dismiss index arguments and offers prices valid to 2028. Casing cover HB is sole-sourced at cost; Pump housing HB 40 is 35 % dearer than co-source 70150 (32.24 vs 43.39). Qualified but unused on three more parts, a strong volume carrot. 44 complaints in 3 years.
notes: Wants price stability matched to its hedge through 2028. Fears losing HB 40 to 70150 and missing new volume. Casing cover has no second source.
